headline_hook: Qwen Ships a 2.4-Trillion-Parameter Coding Giant While Latent Space Cracks Open ChatGPT Work's Agent Architecture

pick_of_the_day.thesis: Latent Space's teardown of ChatGPT Work reveals that OpenAI's real moat isn't model quality — it's the orchestration layer (Memory, Proactivity, Scheduling, Skills) that turns a chatbot into a persistent coworker, and every builder shipping agents should study this playbook before reinventing it.

model_literacy.concept: Active Parameters vs. Total Parameters in MoE Models
model_literacy.relevance: Today's launches include a 2.4T Qwen Max and a 750B K-EXAONE with only 37B active — understanding Mixture-of-Experts routing explains why a 750B model can run on hardware that would choke on a dense 70B, and why raw parameter counts are increasingly misleading as a proxy for capability or cost.

items.title: Qwen 3.8 Max Drops 2.4 Trillion Parameters Aimed Squarely at Coding
items.angle: Alibaba's largest model yet is explicitly positioned against GPT-5 and Claude on code — the 27B coding-optimized variant signals that the real race is specialized performance, not just scale
items.key_fact: 2.4T-parameter Max model plus a 27B coding/cowork variant released simultaneously

items.title: Liquid AI Ships a 2.6B Agent Model Built for Your Phone
items.angle: Purpose-built for on-device agent deployment, already at 47K downloads — the edge-agent category is solidifying fast

items.title: Mistral's Shieldstral: A 3B Open-Weight Safety Filter You Can Run Locally
items.angle: An open-weight multimodal moderation model small enough to bolt onto any pipeline as a guardrail — fills a gap most teams solve with expensive API calls
items.key_fact: 3B parameters, handles both text and image moderation

items.title: LG AI Research Enters the Frontier Ring with a 750B MoE Model
items.angle: K-EXAONE 2.0 from South Korea shows frontier-scale development is no longer a US-China duopoly — 37B active params keep inference tractable
items.key_fact: 750B total parameters, 37B active via MoE routing

items.title: Anthropic Finally Publishes the Claude Cost Control Playbook

items.title: Latent Space Reverse-Engineers How ChatGPT Work Actually Works
items.angle: The most detailed external teardown of OpenAI's agent architecture — Memory, Proactivity, Scheduling, Browser Use, Skills — reveals the orchestration layer that turns a chatbot into a persistent workplace agent
items.key_fact: Identifies six core subsystems: Memory, Proactivity, Scheduling, Browser Use, Plugins, Skills/Tools
